rationale: A ChatGPT session on physical machine 2 currently invokes the legacy gateway-local run_command and observes HOSTNAME=MACHINE_A_HOST. The V2-BD routing surface must make execution-device selection and inferred task placement externally observable before the real two-machine pilot can PASS.

invariants.legacy_semantics: Remain gateway-local compatibility tools. They do not accept device_id/client_id and are not evidence of V2-BD execution routing.
selection_surface: device_list() enumerates paired execution devices and their execution identity
project_register_on_device(..., device_id, ...) explicitly selects the execution device
project_bind_device(..., device_id) explicitly selects/rebinds only where frozen safety rules allow
task_create inherits the selected project device in task_device_bindings
invariants.task_routing: Task-scoped operations must never accept a caller device override. They infer target device exclusively from immutable task_device_bindings.
invariants.oauth_client_not_execution_identity: auth_client_id identifies OAuth/DCR session context and may legitimately be identical across two physical ChatGPT login machines. It MUST NOT be used as execution-device identity.
invariants.execution_identity: Stable device_id (dev_*) is routing authority. device_name and node hostname are observability fields only.

acceptance.current_negative_evidence: From physical machine 2, legacy run_command returned HOSTNAME=MACHINE_A_HOST; this is expected for the still-deployed V2-B gateway-local surface and is NOT a V2-BD PASS.
real_pilot_requires: device_list shows two distinct dev_* execution identities
device A and device B report distinct expected hostnames or equivalent physical-node marker evidence
project A explicitly bound to device A; project B explicitly bound to device B
task A/task B status expose matching routing.device_id and routing.hostname
a routed job on task B prints REMOTEMCP_DEVICE_ID matching device B and socket hostname matching physical machine 2
the same routed operation on task A resolves to physical machine 1
no task tool accepts a device override and no cross-route execution occurs
